implementation_limits: Individual source silhouettes are hand observed control polygons, not exact traced relief or full carving.
Rafter segments touch adjacent circular purlin sections by tangent offset; this is a section study, not structural validation.
Unlabelled openings, section widths and transverse depth remain display approximations.
No exact mortise geometry or historical paint colors inferred.
You-chun source ink remains original diagram ink; it is not a recovered historical pigment palette.
A browser visual inspection is still required after integration.
